ov: Mid-sized game birds of two groups: Old World quail, related to pheasants, and New World quail in a family of their own. Many larger species are farmed for meat and eggs; in 2007 the United States alone produced 40 million quail.

why.p: The king quail is often sold in the pet trade, where it is called a "button quail".
why.et: Many larger species are farm-raised for meat and eggs, or hunted.

rg: Worldwide; the Japanese quail lives mainly in East Asia and Russia.
fx: Japanese quail eggs were taken to space on Soyuz 32 in 1979, and in 1990 quail eggs hatched on the Mir space station.
A group of quail is called a covey or a bevy.
